reasons: El remitente (Thames Valley University) es una institución educativa que solicita una propuesta para un servicio que HealthCore ofrece (red de referidos / alianza con una clínica).
La solicitud es informal (por correo) pero pide explícitamente una propuesta ('Could someone put together a proposal for us?').
Se menciona un plazo (inicio del próximo trimestre, ~25 días) y requisitos de cumplimiento (UK GDPR), lo que indica una intención seria de contratación.

synthesis.summary: Thames Valley University solicita una red de derivación para 3,000 estudiantes, con un plazo de implementación de 25 días a partir del 28 de agosto. El acuerdo debe cumplir con UK GDPR e incluir un DPA. Se requiere un modelo de precios en GBP, selección de una clínica satélite cercana y capacidad operativa para manejar derivaciones de salud estudiantil.
next_steps: Preparar propuesta de precios (tarifa por estudiante, paquete o por derivación) en GBP — Revenue Cycle (Tom Callahan)
Definir términos de pago alineados con el plazo de 25 días — Revenue Cycle (Tom Callahan)
Identificar la clínica satélite más cercana y evaluar su capacidad y personal — Clinical Operations (Dr. Marcus Reid)
Elaborar plan de implementación detallado para lanzar la red en 25 días — Clinical Operations (Dr. Marcus Reid)
Redactar DPA conforme a UK GDPR para el procesamiento de datos de salud estudiantil — Compliance (Claire Whitfield)
Confirmar roles de controlador/procesador y cubrir subcontratistas en el DPA — Compliance (Claire Whitfield)

key_aspects.detail: Define a pricing model for the referral network covering 3,000 students, considering UK GDPR and DPA requirements.
Establish payment terms that align with the tight 25-day timeline to start by August 28th.
All financial terms must be in GBP, and payment methods must comply with UK regulations.

requests: Prepare a pricing proposal for the referral network (e.g., per-student fee, bundled rate, or per-referral charge) based on the 3,000-student population.
Define payment terms (e.g., upfront payment, milestone payments, or monthly invoicing) that fit the 25-day implementation timeline.
Confirm that all financial figures are in GBP and that payment methods comply with UK GDPR and DPA requirements.
open_questions: What is the budget range for this referral network?
What is the expected contract term (e.g., one academic year, multi-year)?
Are there any specific pricing constraints or preferences from the client?

key_aspects.detail: Identify which existing satellite clinic is geographically suitable to serve Thames Valley University's main campus and can handle referral volume from 3,000 students.
Assess current staffing levels at the chosen satellite clinic to determine if they can absorb additional referrals without compromising existing services, and whether additional hires are needed.
Evaluate whether the referral network can be operational within 25 days (by August 28th), including setup of referral pathways, IT systems, and staff training.
Ensure the referral network complies with UK GDPR and a DPA is in place between HealthCore and Thames Valley University for handling student health data.

requests: Prepare a feasibility report identifying the nearest satellite clinic to Thames Valley University, its current capacity, and staffing availability.
Propose a detailed implementation plan to launch the referral network within 25 days, including milestones for contracting, IT integration, and staff onboarding.

Confirm that the satellite clinic can accept referrals for the range of specialist services likely needed by students (e.g., mental health, primary care, etc.) and that referral protocols are established.
Ensure a DPA is drafted and ready for signature to meet UK GDPR requirements.
open_questions: Which specific satellite clinic is closest to Thames Valley University's main campus?
What is the current patient load and available appointment slots at that clinic?
What specialist services are most commonly requested by the university's student population?
What is the expected referral volume per week/month from the 3,000 students?
Are there any existing relationships or contracts with Thames Valley University that could expedite setup?
What IT systems are needed to manage referrals and data sharing, and can they be integrated within 25 days?

key_aspects.aspect: UK GDPR compliance for student health data
key_aspects.detail: The RFP explicitly requires full compliance with UK GDPR because the referral network involves student health data, which is a special category of personal data under the regulation.
Metadata indicates the agreement type is DPA, and UK GDPR mandates a DPA between the university and HealthCore when processing health data on behalf of the university.

key_aspects.aspect: Handling of student health data in referral network
key_aspects.detail: The proposal must address the lawful processing, security, and data subject rights for approximately 3,000 students' health data shared within the referral network.

requests: Prepare a UK GDPR-compliant DPA to be included in the proposal, covering the processing of student health data for the referral network.
Confirm and document the roles of controller and processor, and include required clauses on data subject rights, security measures, and breach notification.
Ensure that all subcontractors (if any) are covered in the DPA and that the proposal reflects UK GDPR obligations for special category data.
open_questions: What specific categories of student health data will be processed in the referral network?
Is there any data transfer outside the UK?
What data retention period applies to the health data?
Are there any third-party processors involved in the referral network besides HealthCore?

open_questions.question: La RFP no indica presupuesto de referencia.
Fecha límite sin año explícito («around August 28th»): confirmar la fecha exacta con el cliente.
